notice.label: Cookie notice
notice.title: We use essential cookies
notice.body: Applika.dev only uses cookies that are strictly necessary to keep you signed in and to protect your session. No analytics, advertising, or tracking cookies are used. <link>Learn more</link>.

policy.title: Cookie Policy
policy.whatBody: Cookies are small text files placed on your device by the websites you visit. They are widely used to make sites work, or work more efficiently, and to provide information to the site owner.
policy.usedBody: {name} uses only strictly necessary cookies, plus one preference cookie that remembers the language you choose. These cookies are required for the site to function and to keep your session secure. We do not use cookies for analytics, advertising, profiling, or third-party tracking.
policy.accessPurpose: Short-lived signed JWT that authenticates each request while you are using the site.
policy.refreshPurpose: Opaque UUID used as a lookup key for your refresh token, which is stored server-side in Redis. Allows the short-lived access token to be renewed without making you sign in again.
policy.localePurpose: Remembers the language you chose: it holds en (English) or pt-BR (Portuguese, Brazil), so every page opens in that language, signed in or not. Set only when you pick a language; nothing is stored on your account.
policy.thirdPartyBody: None. {name} does not embed third-party services that set cookies on your device.
policy.managingBody: Because the cookies we set are strictly necessary, there is no consent toggle to offer: disabling them would prevent you from signing in. You can clear cookies at any time through your browser settings, but doing so will sign you out.
policy.managingLocale: The language cookie is only set when you choose a language. If cookies are blocked, your choice lasts for the page you are on, and the next page follows your browser's language.
policy.changesBody: If our cookie practices change, we will update this page and revise the date above.
policy.footer: Questions? See our <link>home page</link> for contact details.
